headline: The CHU de Bordeaux says investigations confirmed a compromise of its information system; it says patient care is not affected.
summary: New incident page. The hospital's own updates of Nov 23 (s001: two email addresses misused for mass emails to staff, no sign of compromise yet) and Nov 24 (s002: compromise confirmed; ANSSI informed, CNIL notified, complaint to follow; one server cut off from outside access; care continues; people affected to be contacted). The Record (s003) and Egora (s004, citing Sud Ouest and French Breaches) report that Scarlettgroup claims the attack and says it holds medical and staff data; the hospital has not confirmed that. Main answer Confirmed on the hospital's own word plus two outlets, filed under hack-stated; incident_type breach; no service, as nothing public went down. Size Regional, by the hospital's reach; no count given. Theory sweep: no Hacker News thread for the hospital or the group; Reddit could not be read. Privacy check done: no staff, reporters or contact details named.
author: Research agent
